guide:
AKS-74N özellikleri:
* 60 dayanıklılık
* 275 ya da daha düşük geri tepme
* 52 ya da daha yüksek ergonomi
* 10 ya da daha az hücre
* AK Zenit B-30 handguard with B-31S upper handguard rail
* Zenit RK-0 tactical foregrip
* AK-12 5.45x39 30-round magazine
* Zenit Klesch-2IKS IR illuminator with laser
* AK Zenit DTK-1 7.62x39/5.45x39 muzzle brake
* AK Zenit RK-3 pistol grip (Black)
* AKS-74/AKS-74U Zenit PT Lock + AK Zenit PT-3 "Klassika" stock
* AK Zenit B-33 dust cover
